{{Quote|Jedi Knight To-La, who ended the thousand-year War of Flowering Knives.|[[Oniye Namada]] in her [[I-1807-VAK|report]]|<ref name="TTF2" />}}
'''To-La''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual who was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During their service to the Order, To-La ended the [[War of Flowering Knives|War of the Flowering Knives]], a conflict which had been ongoing for one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. For their actions, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was hailed as a hero by the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]], who erected a statue of To-La in a public square. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the dissolution of the Jedi Order, To-La's statue was destroyed as part of a scheme meant to wipe out all memory of the Order's existence on Vaklin, to prevent support of a Jedi lead [[Vaklin insurgency|insurgency]] taking place there. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]] mentioned To-La in report she compiled on the insurgency, titled [[I-1807-VAK]].<ref name="TTF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
To-La was first mentioned in [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Alexander Freed]] and released in [[2013]] and part of the [[Purge (comic book)|''Star Wars: Purge'']] series. The book does not make clear what era they lived in or what their [[Species/Legends|species]] or [[Gender/Legends|gender]] was, although statues in the square include a [[Myneyrsh]] and a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]].
